name: Professor Kingsley
source:
Professor Kingsley is a professor at Belvoire University and one of Your Character's love interests. They are first seen in Book 1, Chapter 1.

Kingsley is a private individual, projecting an air of mystery and unattainability to most people around them. They strive to be professional in their job. However, after meeting Your Character at a bar, they become rather enamored with her (particularly if they have sex). While they initially try to resist their feelings, Your Character can continually try to break down their walls and convince them to give in.

[spoiler]If Your Character is not romancing Kingsley in any way, their behavior steadily becomes creepy and obsessive. Even if Your Character has told Kingsley she has no interest in them, they will constantly text her, show up at her dorm after they've been fired for being accused of fraternizing with a student (Your Character), and appear at student parties Your Character is attending.[/spoiler]
